tasks.name: VAD
tasks.title: Speech activity (VAD)
tasks.description: Speech regions. Other segment-level tasks are computed on these regions.
tasks.prompt: Mark every region of this recording that contains human speech.

tasks.name: ASR
tasks.title: Speech recognition
tasks.description: Verbatim transcript per speech segment.
tasks.prompt: Transcribe the speech in this segment verbatim, in the language it is spoken. Keep disfluencies and repetitions. Do not translate or summarize.

tasks.name: FA words
tasks.title: Forced alignment (words)
tasks.description: Word-level timestamps aligned to the ASR transcript.
tasks.prompt: Align each word of the given transcript to the audio and return its start and end time in seconds.

tasks.name: Phones
tasks.title: Phoneme recognition
tasks.description: Phone sequence in IPA with timestamps.
tasks.prompt: Recognize the phones spoken in this segment. Use IPA symbols and give each phone a start and end time in seconds.

tasks.name: LID
tasks.title: Language identification
tasks.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code.
tasks.prompt: Identify the language spoken in this segment. Answer with its ISO 639-1 code.

tasks.name: S2TT
tasks.title: Speech translation (to English)
tasks.description: English translation of each speech segment.
tasks.prompt: Translate the speech in this segment into fluent English.

tasks.name: NER
tasks.title: Named entities
tasks.description: Named entities mentioned in each segment, written as 'entity [TYPE]'.
tasks.prompt: List the named entities mentioned in this segment. Write each as 'entity text [TYPE]' using the given entity types.

tasks.name: Sentiment
tasks.title: Sentiment
tasks.description: Polarity of what is said.
tasks.prompt: Classify the sentiment of what the speaker says in this segment.

tasks.name: Topic
tasks.title: Topic classification
tasks.description: Main topic of the whole recording.
tasks.prompt: What is the main topic of this recording?

tasks.name: Speaker
tasks.title: Speaker diarization
tasks.description: Who spoke when. Open label set: SPEAKER_0, SPEAKER_1, ...
tasks.prompt: Assign a consistent speaker label (SPEAKER_0, SPEAKER_1, ...) to this segment so that the same voice always gets the same label.

tasks.name: Gender
tasks.title: Speaker gender
tasks.description: Perceived gender of the speaker.
tasks.prompt: What is the perceived gender of the speaker in this segment?

tasks.name: Age
tasks.title: Speaker age group
tasks.description: Perceived age group of the speaker.
tasks.prompt: Estimate the age group of the speaker in this segment.

tasks.name: Accent
tasks.title: Accent / dialect
tasks.description: Short description of the accent or dialect.
tasks.prompt: Describe the accent or dialect of the speaker in a few words (for example 'Scottish English' or 'Swiss German').

tasks.name: SER
tasks.title: Speech emotion recognition
tasks.description: Emotion conveyed by the voice.
tasks.prompt: Which emotion does the speaker's voice convey in this segment? Consider tone, pitch and intensity, not only the words.

tasks.name: Style
tasks.title: Speaking style
tasks.description: Register and delivery of the speech.
tasks.prompt: Classify the speaking style in this segment.

tasks.name: Non-verbal
tasks.title: Non-verbal vocalizations
tasks.description: Laughter, coughs, breaths and other vocal events with timestamps.
tasks.prompt: Find every non-verbal vocalization (laughter, cough, breath, sigh, crying, throat clearing, fillers) and give its start and end time in seconds.

tasks.name: Quality
tasks.title: Audio quality
tasks.description: Recording quality: noise, reverberation, clipping.
tasks.prompt: Rate the recording quality of this segment, considering background noise, reverberation and distortion.

tasks.name: MOS
tasks.title: Naturalness (MOS 1-5)
tasks.description: Mean opinion score for naturalness, e.g. for TTS evaluation.
tasks.prompt: Rate how natural this speech sounds on a scale from 1 (very unnatural) to 5 (completely natural).

tasks.name: Events
tasks.title: Sound event detection
tasks.description: Sound events with timestamps.
tasks.prompt: Detect the sound events in this recording and give each event's start and end time in seconds.

tasks.name: Scene
tasks.title: Acoustic scene
tasks.description: Where the recording was made.
tasks.prompt: Classify the acoustic environment of this recording.

tasks.name: FER
tasks.title: Facial expression
tasks.description: Facial expression of the main visible person.
tasks.prompt: What facial expression does the main visible person show?

tasks.name: AV-Emo
tasks.title: Audio-visual emotion
tasks.description: Emotion from voice and face together.
tasks.prompt: Using both the voice and the face of the speaker, which emotion is expressed in this segment?

tasks.name: On-screen
tasks.title: Active speaker (visual)
tasks.description: Is the person speaking visible on screen?
tasks.prompt: Is the person who is speaking in this segment visible on screen?

tasks.name: Action
tasks.title: Action recognition
tasks.description: Short verb phrase describing what people are doing.
tasks.prompt: In a short verb phrase, what is the main person doing in this clip?

tasks.name: Shots
tasks.title: Shot boundaries
tasks.description: Camera shots / cuts.
tasks.prompt: Split this video into camera shots and give the start and end time of each shot in seconds.

tasks.name: OCR
tasks.title: On-screen text (OCR)
tasks.description: Text visible in the frame.
tasks.prompt: Transcribe all text that is visible in the frame. Return an empty string if there is none.

tasks.name: Tags
tasks.title: Object & scene tags
tasks.description: Visible objects and scene attributes.
tasks.prompt: Which of the given tags apply to this image?

tasks.name: AudioCap
tasks.title: Audio captioning
tasks.description: One-sentence description of what can be heard.
tasks.prompt: Describe in one or two sentences what can be heard in this recording, including sounds, voices and music.

tasks.name: VoiceCap
tasks.title: Speaking-style captioning
tasks.description: Free-text description of voice, emotion, pace and delivery.
tasks.prompt: Describe how the speaker sounds in this segment: voice quality, pitch, pace, emotion and delivery. Do not repeat the words that are said.

tasks.name: VidCap
tasks.title: Video captioning
tasks.description: Summary of the whole video.
tasks.prompt: Describe this video in two or three sentences: who is in it, where it takes place and what happens.

tasks.name: Dense
tasks.title: Dense video captioning
tasks.description: A caption for every few seconds of video.
tasks.prompt: Describe what happens in this part of the video in one sentence.

tasks.name: ImgCap
tasks.title: Image captioning
tasks.description: One-sentence caption.
tasks.prompt: Write a one-sentence caption for this image.

tasks.name: Detail
tasks.title: Detailed image description
tasks.description: Paragraph-length description of everything visible.
tasks.prompt: Describe this image in detail: the people, objects, setting, colors, actions and any visible text.

tasks.name: FaceCap
tasks.title: Face & person description
tasks.description: Appearance, expression and pose of the main person.
tasks.prompt: Describe the main person's face and appearance: expression, gaze, head pose, approximate age, and visible attributes.
